headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: ECI clarifies previous voters can submit Form-6 during SIR without fear of prosecution.
Cancer registry in Telangana has logged 35,000 cases, government advisor informs Minister.
Railway construction near 118-year-old school in Mysuru sparks fresh row.
bullets_ur: ECI ne wazeh kiya ke purane voters SIR ke dauran karrawai ke darr ke baghair Form-6 jama kara sakte hain
Telangana mein cancer registry ne 35,000 cases darj kiye hain, hukumat ke advisor ne Minister ko bata diya.
Mysuru mein 118 saal purane school ke qareeb railway ki taameer se naya tanaza khara ho gaya
